name: The Window Lender
description: The token of THE WINDOW's lender agent: the autonomous lender on the other side of every overnight window of a private margin desk for tokenized stocks on Solana. It lends against tokenized-stock collateral proven solvent in zero knowledge and earns the xONIA rate. Launched on a Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve quoted in a tokenized stock, configured from the desk's own numbers. Not investment advice; a hackathon project (Stocklana, September 2026).
